description: Legitimate output that repeats exactly: a Tetris board literal and a platformer map with 8 identical empty rows in an answer after ordinary code, and a turn that reasons briefly and then renames a type at 15 identical call sites in one patch inside a tool call (made up, with the shape of a real correct patch that fired the short-block stop on 2026-09-22). Token ids from the Qwen 3.8 27B tokenizer. Both repetition stops fire on these, which is why the server leaves them off by default.
